why: The bottom row shows two half-circles that together make a whole circle. The hourglass on top is made of two trapezium halves; if they are joined with their wide sides together, they make a six-sided figure (hexagon). Option 2 is that tall hexagon. Option 1 has 7 sides, so it is wrong.
trick: Two halves joined together make one whole shape; look for the shape made by the joined parts.
